text:
Ten teams played in Modern Warfare 4’s new DMZ mode

MrBeast Gaming published a video on October 19 called If You Escape, You Win $1,000,000, where ten teams played Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’s new DMZ mode on the Hajin map. Each team started with $100,000, and teams could take rivals’ dog tags and cash but only kept it by reaching extraction. The video came out a day before DMZ early access opened on October 20, and MrBeast called it a full circle moment since he started on YouTube posting Call of Duty videos. Would you watch more COD content from him?

Source: GameSpot, YouTube (MrBeast Gaming)
